name: codexasset-linux
install: set -euo pipefail && curl -fsSL https://packages.microsoft.com/config/ubuntu/24.04/packages-microsoft-prod.deb -o /tmp/packages-microsoft-prod.deb && sudo dpkg -i /tmp/packages-microsoft-prod.deb && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0 && dotnet restore tests/AssetManagement.Tests/AssetManagement.Tests.csproj && dotnet build tests/AssetManagement.Tests/AssetManagement.Tests.csproj -c Release
start: echo 'CodexAsset: Web/IIS not available on Linux; use dotnet test for verification.'
